culture: Piazza Navona in Rome is a famous square where street painters have worked for centuries
The Fountain of the Four Rivers (Fontana dei Quattro Fiumi) is in Piazza Navona
Piazza Navona has three fountains, including the Fountain of the Moor (Fontana del Moro), which Romans love
The Trevi Fountain is another famous fountain in Rome
Rome's light is considered unique, especially at sunset
Tourists flock to look at the fountains in Rome's squares
Buongiorno means good morning
Grazie mille means thank you very much
Arrivederci means goodbye
A domani means see you tomorrow
Buona giornata means have a good day
Italian polite address uses the formal 'lei' with strangers (e.g. 'Le piace...?', 'Venga a trovarmi')
Mi piace / Le piace means I like / do you like
Dipingere means to paint; paesaggi are landscapes and ritratti are portraits
Che bello! is an expression meaning how nice!
